additional_info.subject: Log Analysis
additional_info.body:
EV started at 67%.
- Charging started on Outlet 2 with all CGs allocated. (QA09-10, 11-12, 15-16 > closed)
- After few minutes charger released DC3 by opening QA15-16 (QA09-10, 11-12 > closed)
EV > 70%
- charger released DC4 by opening QA11-12 (QA09-10 > closed)
EV > 75%
- charger release DC1 by opening QA09-10, but trigger the error coil stuck on ON feedback for QA09-10, and charger put the DC1 CG on Faulted until charging on Outlet 2 stops.
It might be because of safety reasons.
Will check if there are other transactions which have same patterns.

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0371037-DC/Si-D/FR-[UlTc32] Charging issue CRM:00798001060
additional_info.body:
Hi Malek,
We have analyzed the logs for the provided timestamp and found that the charger received an ON feedback from the contactor related to outlet 1. This feedback might be false and, for security reasons, it caused the charger to put outlet 1 into an unavailable state.
We are investigating this further and, if a site visit is required, we will inform our service team accordingly.
We will keep you posted on our progress.
Thank you.
Best Regards,
Vishal Dhiman
eMobility Support Team
Please do not change the subject line with replying back to this email.

additional_info.subject: Analysis.
additional_info.body:
QA 09-10 happed 4 times in last 4 weeks.
every time charger release DC1 or DC2 CG, QA09-10 gives "coil stuck on ON".
